thread:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch prioritization. We have 3 customer P1/P2 bugs and ~8 enhancement asks. Can we agree on a 2-week slice for P1-2 + 2 small UX enh? Otherwise everything else goes to backlog.

Cesar: +1 to fixing P1 and P2 in the next sprint. P1 is causing request timeouts for 3 enterprise customers (see logs), SLA risk. P2 is a data-mapping edgecase.

Anna: P1 stacktrace: `RuntimeError: kv cache overflow at sequence 1024`. We can patch by clamping sequence window — ~1.5 engineer-days + test. P2 needs a mapping table update and a migration, ~2 eng-days.

Sam: Important to note: the patch for P1 may slightly increase latency for 99th pct. We should measure before committing to release. Could be a toggle. :thinking_face:

Maya: Good call. Proposal: implement P1 behind a feature flag + telemetry, fix P2 fully, and pick 2 UX enhancements that are low-risk. Any blockers?

Cesar: Which UX enh are you thinking? I flagged: (A) clearer retry messaging on client side, (B) compact response mode toggle in SDK, (C) shorter default context window in console. A and B are small. B affects SDK surface area though.

Anna: A is just copy + a small client change — 0.5d. B needs SDK bump and changelog — ~1d. C touches console and stored prefs — ~2d.

Sam: For risk profile pick A + B. B can ship as opt-in in SDK and we can coordinate semver.

Maya: Timeline check: sprint starts Monday. We need rollout runway: canary -> 48h -> full. Is that enough for P1 feature-flag telemetry?

Cesar: Yes if Anna starts today. I'll own the canary plan (regions, traffic %) and rollback playbook.

product-bot: Created checklist https://jira.redwood/PLAT-4523 (P1 patch behind flag, P2 migration, UX A+B). Assigned: Anna, Cesar, Sam.

Anna: One more thing — P2 migration has a DB backfill that will take ~3 hours on staging. Need a quick e2e run window.

Maya: Noted. We'll reserve Wed 10:00–13:00 for e2e + canary.

Cesar: On tradeoffs: if we push B to backlog, we save ~1 dev-day to allocate to deeper latency regression tests for P1. Worth considering if 99th pct impact is uncertain.

Sam: Agree. If the feature flag gives us visibility, we can iterate. But if risk outweighs visibility, prefer to spend the day on regression harness and throttling tests.

Maya: Final vote: ship P1 behind flag, full P2, UX A for sure, defer B unless Anna can squeeze it without delaying canary. Cesar/Sam — thumbs? :thumbsup:

Cesar: :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup:

Anna: I'll try to land B as opt-in patch; if I hit blockers I won't block canary.

Maya: Great. Action items: 1) Anna — P1 patch + opt-in SDK change (if possible) — ticket PLAT-4523-1. 2) Cesar — canary plan & rollback playbook — ticket PLAT-4523-2. 3) Sam — e2e window coordination & perf smoke tests — ticket PLAT-4523-3.

product-bot: Reminder: next sync Thu 09:30 to review canary metrics and decide full rollout.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap board and customer comms draft for those affected.

Cesar: Will ping legal for customer-facing note templates.

Sam: I'll prepare the perf dashboard (99/95/50 pct) and add the new telemetry metric for the feature flag.

Anna: Starting the patch now, ETA EOD for initial PR.

Maya: Perfect — closing thread, leaving notes in the sprint ticket. :raised_hands:
